description: This Java class 'PolicyIdReferencePlaceholderResolver' resolves policy IDs of referenced entities, specifically handling retrieval of policy IDs from 'Thing' entities via an actor-based communication pattern, integrating with the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: PolicyIdReferencePlaceholderResolver
classes.description: Handles resolving policy IDs for referenced entities, specifically retrieving policy IDs from 'Thing' entities through actor communication.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the policy ID reference by invoking the appropriate strategy based on entity type.

methods.name: handlePolicyIdReference
methods.description: Performs the retrieval of a policy ID from a 'Thing' entity via actor messaging.

methods.name: handleRetrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Processes responses from 'RetrieveThing' commands, extracting the policy ID or throwing exceptions on errors.

methods.name: unknownFieldException
methods.description: Creates an exception if the referenced field is missing in the retrieved entity.

methods.name: notSupportedException
methods.description: Creates an exception if the entity type is not supported.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the resolver.
